title: Walkin Refrigerator/ Freezer Replacement
description_text: This notice issues the Request for Quote, Solicitation # W50S7T-26-B-A003 (formerly W50S7T-26-A-0002), Walkin Refrigerator/ Freezer Replacement, Project # FSS_UFR_2605. Please refer to the attached Solicitation, Attachment 1 - SOW. Site visit date, time, and location are identified in the subject solicitation. Please read the solicitation and other documents thoroughly and abide by the solicitation requirements. This project is currently subject to funds availability. Bids should be available for a minimum of 60 days.
